killedBy: the selectors picks the gameplay canvas by structure, so a new HUD canvas cannot win it
the selectors names an element the shipped page actually has
why: Restores the exact selector that shipped and failed TWICE. It is a denylist of the HUD canvases known at the time it was written: a bare `canvas` lost to the Customize preview when the route UI began building before a session (issue #468), the preview was excluded by class, and the same shape returned the moment issue #274 gave each versus map card a board schematic. MEASURED both times rather than reasoned -- CI and a local run each reported the visual gate's probe reading `bufferWidth: 132, bufferHeight: 108, hasContext: false`, a schematic canvas, while every screenshot-based check on the same run passed (board 71.3% painted, 96.7% of width). The gate was therefore reporting a renderer failure that had not happened, which is the worst failure a gate has. NOTHING ELSE CATCHES IT: `npm run visual` and `npm run gallery` both need a real browser and neither runs under vitest, so the unit suite's only purchase on this rule is the structural fixture the killing case builds -- a page with the HUD and its two canvases BEFORE the gameplay canvas, which is the document order the real page has and the reason a denylist ever went wrong.
